```{r}
runrf <- function(Y, indice, n_lags = 0, ntree, mtry) {

  y <- Y[, indice]
  X <- Y[, -indice]
  
  # Split into train vs prediction point
  X.train <- X[-nrow(X), ]
  y.train <- y[-length(y)]
  
  X.out <- matrix(X[nrow(X), ], nrow = 1)
  
  model <- randomForest(
    x = X.train,
    y = y.train,
    ntree = ntree,
    importance = TRUE,
    mtry = mtry
  )
  
  pred <- predict(model, X.out)
  
  return(list(model = model, pred = pred))
}


runrf_shap <- function(Y, indice, n_lags = 0, ntree, mtry) {

  y <- Y[, indice]
  X <- Y[, -indice]
  
  # Train / test split
  X.train <- X[-nrow(X), ]
  y.train <- y[-length(y)]
  
  X.out <- X[nrow(X), , drop = FALSE]
  
  model <- randomForest(
    x = X.train,
    y = y.train,
    ntree = ntree,
    importance = TRUE,
    mtry = mtry
  )
  
  pred <- predict(model, X.out)
  
  # ---- SHAP computation ----
  shap_values <- fastshap::explain(
    object = model,
    X = X.train,
    newdata = X.out,
    pred_wrapper = function(object, newdata) {
      predict(object, newdata)
    },
    nsim = 50  # increase (e.g. 100–500) for more stable estimates
  )
  
  return(list(
    model = model,
    pred = pred,
    shap = shap_values
  ))
}

rf.rolling.window_shap =function(Y,nprev,indice=1, ntree, mtry){
  save.importance=list()
  save.pred=matrix(NA,nprev,1)
  save.shap=list()   # NEW
  
  for(i in nprev:1){
    Y.window=Y[(1+nprev-i):(nrow(Y)-i),]
    
    rf=runrf_shap(Y.window,indice,0,ntree, mtry)
    
    idx = (1+nprev-i)
    
    save.pred[idx,]=rf$pred
    save.importance[[i]]=importance(rf$model)
    save.shap[[idx]] = rf$shap   # store SHAP
    
    cat("iteration", idx,"\n")
  }
  
  real=Y[,indice]
  
  rmse=sqrt(mean((tail(real,nprev)-save.pred)^2))
  mae=mean(abs(tail(real,nprev)-save.pred))
  
  errors=c("rmse"=rmse,"mae"=mae)
  
  return(list(
    #pred=save.pred,
    #errors=errors,
    save.importance=save.importance,
    shap_values = save.shap   
  ))
}

#This function will repeatedly call the previous function in the rolling window h-step forecasting
#Inputs for the function:
#1) Data matrix Y: includes all variables
#2) nprev - number of out-of-sample observations (at the end of the sample)
#3) indice - indice of the location of y var
#4) ntree - number of trees to fit for the forest
#5) mtry - number of predictors to for the forest 


rf.rolling.window=function(Y,nprev,indice=1, ntree, mtry){
  save.importance=list() #blank for saving variable importance
  save.pred=matrix(NA,nprev,1) ##blank for forecasts
  for(i in nprev:1){#NB: backwards FOR loop: going from 105 down to 1
    Y.window=Y[(1+nprev-i):(nrow(Y)-i),] #define the estimation window (first one: 1 to 491, then 2 to 492 etc.)
    rf=runrf(Y.window,indice,0,ntree, mtry) #call the function to fit the Random Forest and generate h-step forecast
    save.pred[(1+nprev-i),]=rf$pred #save the forecast
    save.importance[[i]]=importance(rf$model) #save variable importance
    cat("iteration",(1+nprev-i),"\n") #display iteration number
  }
  
  
  real=Y[,indice]#get actual values
  #plot(real,type="l")
  #lines(c(rep(NA,length(real)-nprev),save.pred),col="red") #padded with NA for blanks, plot predictions vs. actual
  
  rmse=sqrt(mean((tail(real,nprev)-save.pred)^2)) #compute RMSE
  mae=mean(abs(tail(real,nprev)-save.pred)) #compute MAE (Mean Absolute Error)
  errors=c("rmse"=rmse,"mae"=mae) #stack errors in a vector
  
  return(list("pred"=save.pred,"errors"=errors,"save.importance"=save.importance)) #return forecasts, history of variable importance, and RMSE and MAE for the period.
}
```

```{r}
#Goes through mtry and ntree and selects best ntree based on lowest RMSE on validation Set 
rf.select_parameter = function(Y, nprev, indice = 1, parameters_ntree, parameters_mtry){
  rmse_all <- list()
  best_parameter_ntree <- NA 
  best_parameter_mtry <- NA
  lowest_rmse <- Inf 
  
  for (i in parameters_ntree){
    for (j in parameters_mtry){
      curr_model = rf.rolling.window(Y, nprev, indice, i, j)
      rmse = curr_model$errors['rmse']
      preds = curr_model$pred 
      
      # Combined key of ntree and mtry 
      key <- paste0("ntree_", i, "_mtry_", j)
      rmse_all[[key]] <- rmse
      
      if (rmse <= lowest_rmse){
        best_parameter_ntree = i 
        best_parameter_mtry = j
        lowest_rmse <- rmse 
      }
    }
  }
  return(list(best_parameter_ntree, best_parameter_mtry, rmse_all))
}
```

## Coin Numbers 
```{r}
#Extract unique coins 
all_coins <- c(unique(df_clean$coin))
results_all_coins = list()

#Number of train/test/valid
train_BCH_num = nrow(df_clean_BCH %>% filter(week <= "2022-12-30") %>%
  filter(week >= "2018-01-01"))

valid_BCH_num = nrow(df_clean_BCH %>% filter(week > "2022-12-30") %>%
  filter(week <= "2024-12-30"))

test_BCH_num = nrow(df_clean_BCH %>% filter(week > "2024-12-30") %>%
  filter(week <= "2026-01-08")) 
```

## Parallel Computing to save all coins and its best parameter
## Note: This chunk will take very long to run, best run is saved as results/random_forest/results_all_coins_15000.rds
```{r}
# Setup cluster
set.seed(4211)
n_cores <- parallel::detectCores() - 1
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
registerDoSNOW(cl)

# Export functions + data
clusterExport(cl, c("runrf", "rf.rolling.window", "rf.select_parameter",
                    "df_clean", "valid_BCH_num", "test_BCH_num", "train_BCH_num"))

clusterSetRNGStream(cl, 4211)

# Progress bar
pb <- txtProgressBar(max = length(all_coins), style = 3)
progress <- function(n) setTxtProgressBar(pb, n)
opts <- list(progress = progress)

# Parallel loop
results_all_coins <- foreach(
  i = all_coins,
  .packages = c("dplyr", "randomForest"),
  .options.snow = opts
) %dopar% {

  coin_remove_var <- df_clean %>%
    filter(coin == i) 
  
  ## Train + validation data
  train_valid_df <- coin_remove_var %>%
    filter(week <= "2024-12-30") %>%
    filter(week >= "2018-01-01") %>%
    arrange(week) %>%
    select(-c("week", "coin"))
  
  ## Parameter tuning
  rf_train_data <- rf.select_parameter(
    as.matrix(train_valid_df),
    valid_BCH_num,
    indice = 1,
    c(10,50,100,150,300,500,1000,5000),
    c(1,2,3,4,5,7,15,25,35,47)
  )
  
  best_param_ntree <- rf_train_data[[1]]
  best_param_mtry  <- rf_train_data[[2]]
  
  ## Prediction data
  preds_df <- coin_remove_var %>%
    filter(week >= "2018-01-01") %>%
    filter(week < "2026-01-09") %>%
    arrange(week) %>%
    tail(test_BCH_num + train_BCH_num) %>%
    select(-c("week", "coin"))
  
  ## Rolling prediction
  model_preds <- rf.rolling.window(
    as.matrix(preds_df),
    test_BCH_num,
    indice = 1,
    best_param_ntree,
    best_param_mtry
  )
  
  result <- list(
    model_preds = model_preds,
    best_ntree = best_param_ntree,
    best_mtry = best_param_mtry
  )
  
  # ✅ SAFE checkpoint save (one file per coin)
  saveRDS(result, paste0("temp_result_", i, ".rds"))
  
  result
}

# Stop cluster
stopCluster(cl)
close(pb)

# Name results
results_all_coins <- setNames(results_all_coins, all_coins)

# Final save
saveRDS(results_all_coins, "results_all_coins_15000.rds")
```



## Saving Best Results 
```{r}

best_results <- readRDS("../results/random_forest/results_all_coins_15000.rds")


df_preds <- data.frame()
for (i in all_coins){
  #print(i)
  df_preds_temp <- data.frame(prediction = best_results[[i]]$model_preds$pred) 
  
  df_actual <- df_clean %>%
    filter(coin == i) %>%
    arrange(week) %>%
    tail(53) %>%
    select(coin,week, ret_1w) %>%
    rename(actual = ret_1w)
  
  df_temp <- cbind(df_actual,df_preds_temp) %>%
    mutate(residual = actual - prediction)
  
  df_preds <- rbind(df_temp, df_preds)
  
}

rownames(df_preds) <- NULL

write.csv(df_preds, "../results/residuals/rf_residuals.csv")
```


## Saving RMSE of Best Result 
```{r}
df_rmse <- data.frame()

for (i in all_coins){
  df_temp_rmse <- data.frame(rmse = best_results[[i]]$model_preds$errors[1], mae =  best_results[[i]]$model_preds$errors[2]) %>%
    mutate(coin = i) %>%
    select(coin, rmse, mae)
  df_rmse <- rbind(df_temp_rmse, df_rmse)
}

rownames(df_rmse) <- NULL

write.csv(df_rmse, "../results/rmse/rf_rmse.csv")
```
